ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a black rectangular integrated circuit chip, with text such as "HOL TEX", "HT-126", and "A4SDB0421" printed on the front. The metal pins of the chip are arranged on two opposite long sides, namely the upper and lower sides of the image; there are no pins on the two short sides. The pin pitch is relatively dense, and it looks like a surface-mount outward-extending bent-lead structure. Reasoning: The question asks for the package type of the integrated circuit in the figure. A rectangular IC with dense surface-mount pins only on two sides conforms to the typical characteristics of a small outline package. Different from QFP, which has pins on all four sides, and QFN/BGA, which have no outward-extending pins, this figure belongs to the characteristics of an SOP package. Therefore the package type is Small Outline Package, namely SOP package.
